facts.fact: The IFAD RemitSCOPE diagnostic says Western Union and MoneyGram offer online products using debit/credit cards or a bank account for sending to Cabo Verde, with France, Portugal and United States named as main send corridors.
The IFAD RemitSCOPE diagnostic reports the average cost of sending to Cabo Verde online from a debit or credit card at 3.34 per cent, against 6.56 per cent through an agent (Q3 2021).
